question: Does the company track and report its greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions?
Has the company set carbon-reduction or net-zero targets?

choices.A: Yes, with a specific year and measurable target
choices.B: Yes, but targets are vague / unverified

question: Does the company monitor its energy consumption?
What share of the company's energy comes from renewable sources?
Does the company have a water-management or water-reduction programme?
Does the company measure and manage its waste generation?
Does the company assess its climate-related physical and transition risks?

choices.A: Yes, aligned with TCFD or similar framework

question: Does the company have an environmental policy or management system (e.g. ISO 14001)?
Does the company consider environmental factors when selecting suppliers?
Does the company disclose environmental data in an annual report or sustainability report?
Does the company have a formal health & safety (H&S) policy?

choices.A: Yes, with regular audits and KPIs

question: Does the company track employee injury or accident rates?
Does the company offer employee training and professional-development programmes?
Does the company have a diversity, equity & inclusion (DEI) policy?
Does the company measure employee satisfaction or engagement?

choices.A: Yes, regular surveys with action plans

question: Does the company pay at least the local living wage to all employees?
Does the company engage with and support local communities?

choices.A: Yes, with dedicated programmes and budget

question: Does the company have a human-rights or fair-labour policy that covers its supply chain?
Does the company collect and analyse customer satisfaction data?
Does the company provide parental leave or flexible working arrangements?
Does the company have a board or governance body that oversees ESG issues?
Does the company have a formal code of conduct or ethics policy?
Does the company have an anti-corruption or anti-bribery policy?
Does the company have a whistleblower / speak-up mechanism?
Does the company have a data-privacy and cybersecurity policy (e.g. GDPR-aligned)?
Does the company conduct regular financial audits by an independent auditor?
Does the company publicly disclose its ownership structure and key management?
Does the company align its ESG reporting with a recognised standard (GRI, SASB, UN SDGs)?
Does the company have a formal risk-management framework that covers ESG risks?

choices.A: Yes, integrated into enterprise risk management

question: Does the company set measurable ESG targets and report on progress annually?

choices.A: Yes, all three pillars (E, S, G)
choices.B: Yes, one or two pillars only
choices.C: Targets exist but progress not reported
